methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing for leading video-conferencing platforms was collected from each vendor's official pricing page (or a reputable 2026 aggregator page when the official page returned 403/JS-only) on 2026-06-14 and normalized to USD. Where a vendor prices per seat, monthlyUsd records the per-seat list price at the annual-billing rate (consistent with how pricing is most commonly advertised); the month-to-month rate is noted in plan notes when both were observed. Quote-only / contact-sales tiers carry monthlyUsd = null rather than an estimate. Whereby's Pro tier is flat-rate (single host) while its Business tier is priced per host (3-host minimum); GoTo Meeting is priced per organizer. These are non-telephony video-conferencing products, so minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null on every plan. hipaa/baa/bilingual are null unless a vendor explicitly states compliance on the pricing page. Zoom's official pricing page rendered JS-only (no prices extracted); USD figures from GetApp (last updated March 2026) and corroborated by softwareadvice.com. Google Workspace official page geo-resolved to EUR; USD rates confirmed via workspace.google.com with gl=US query parameter and corroborated by GetApp (March 2026). GoTo Meeting and Webex official pages returned HTTP 403; figures from GetApp (last updated June 2026) corroborated by softwareadvice.com and costbench.com (Webex Suite Business confirmed at $22.50/user/mo annual, $27 month-to-month, 17% annual discount). Microsoft Teams prices fetched directly from microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-teams/compare-microsoft-teams-options and corroborated by GetApp.
